description.fallback: [Anime-only side story] With the events of the Land of Rice Fields behind them, everyone prepares for their training. But, a new threat soon arises. Mizuki is back, and he's planning to break out of Konoha's Correctional Facility along with the help of Fūjin and Raijin, the Legendary Stupid Brothers.
